calibration: expected calibration error over 10 confidence bins

criteria.failure: H1 balanced accuracy is negligible or favours the original model
criteria.interaction: for each family, the history gain with the hour (I1 to I3) minus the gain without it (I0 to I2), per household; positive means time and history are complementary
criteria.materially_more: H1 equals the explicit-history model's history gain (H2) minus the original model's (R1) on the same homes. Materially more means H1 favours the model: at least the declared minimal difference, with its interval above zero. The earlier +0.021 is re-measured as R1 and is not a threshold
criteria.success: H1 balanced accuracy favours the explicit-history model, and H1 log loss and H1 calibration error do not favour the original model
criteria.verdicts: favours model: mean >= delta and lower bound > 0; favours reference: mean <= -delta and upper bound < 0; negligible: the whole interval within (-delta, delta); uncertain: anything else
criteria.with_the_hour: S1 is judged by the same rule
